Credit concentration: all-bank credit of Rs 832,527 Cr at a 151.1% credit-deposit ratio (RBI, end-Mar-2025) leaves little deposit cushion, so any deterioration in MSME asset quality constrains further lending to the sector.
brief.local_news: Local coverage adds a specific, dated cash-flow event beyond the data pack: AP Chambers' October 2026 representation seeking release of about ₹5,000 crore in pending MSME and food-processing incentives, noting only around ₹1,000 crore was released the previous year and that delays have hurt loan repayment and working capital. The articles also flag the CII Partnership Summit in Visakhapatnam on November 12-13, 2026 as the deadline pressure point for clearing dues.

GST turnover versus bank credit summations: reconcile declared GST turnover against bank statement credits for the last 12 months, in light of AP GST at -0.2% Apr-to-date versus India +6.1% (GSTN, to Sep-2026).

Electricity bills trend versus last year: pull 12 months of power bills and compare YoY, testing whether the borrower's consumption tracks the state's +18.1% Apr-to-date and +23.0% YoY latest-month demand (CEA, to Aug-2026) or is losing share.
brief.change_the_call: A move in AP GST collections from -0.2% Apr-to-date to positive territory near India's +6.1%, or evidence that the ₹5,000 crore incentive backlog is cleared, would shift the call toward In line; a reversal of electricity demand growth below India's +9.5% would push it to Worse.
